Service overview

About Two-Step Decontamination Wash.

A deeper exterior wash that targets contamination a standard wash cannot remove. Chemical iron and tar treatments leave paintwork cleaner, smoother and ready for protection or polishing.

Key points

What this service covers

  • Safe multi-stage wash
  • Iron fallout treatment
  • Targeted tar removal
  • Protective finish

We inspect the vehicle first and tailor the process to its condition.

Frequently asked

Good to know.

How do I know which vehicle size to choose?

Small generally covers city cars, Medium covers saloons and family hatchbacks, Large covers estates and crossovers, and Extra Large covers large SUVs, 4x4s and vans. We will confirm it before the booking.

How long will the service take?

Timing depends on the selected treatment, vehicle size and current condition. We will provide an expected completion time when confirming your appointment.

Do you inspect the vehicle first?

Yes. We check the vehicle and discuss any areas needing extra attention before starting so expectations are clear.

Where is Auto Opulence based?

Auto Opulence is at Unit 7 Consensus House, St Faiths Road, Norwich, NR6 7BW.
